subject: Are we deprioritizing Redwood? Quick pulse and suggested 15-min next step
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@brightgrid.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Jan 2027 10:12:00 +0000
Subject: Quick discovery recap + suggested next step

Hi Elena — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our 30-min discovery: 

- Primary use case: reduce per-request inference cost for BrightGrid's in-product summarization while meeting a 200–300ms p95 latency target for interactive sessions.
- Current infra: in-house GPU fleet + bursts to cloud; pain points are unpredictable latency spikes during traffic peaks and high costs for long-context jobs.
- Success metric for a pilot: 20–30% token cost reduction at equivalent quality OR equivalent cost with p95 latency < 350ms.
- Constraints: data residency in EU, SOC2 evidence required, pilot limited to non-production traffic.

Attachments: Redwood-discovery-recap.pdf (summary slides + proposed pilot scope)

Suggested next step: 15 minutes to walk through the pilot guardrails and pricing ranges. I have availability Tue/Wed afternoon (CEST). If now's not the right time, can you confirm whether this is still on BrightGrid's roadmap for Q1, deprioritized, or deferred to H2? A one-line update is totally fine.

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Elena — looping back on my note below. No pressure — I just want to make sure we're not losing momentum. Two quick asks: 

1) Can you share a one-line status update (on-roadmap / deprioritized / waiting on vendor legal)?
2) If this is still on the roadmap, would Thu 15:00–15:15 CEST or Fri 10:00–10:15 CEST work for a 15-min sync to confirm pilot scope and cost band?

For reference, I added a short HubSpot note with proposed pilot milestones: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/BrightGrid (HubSpot record).

If you've decided to deprioritize, totally understood — a brief shout is helpful so we can pause outreach. If helpful, Marissa (cc'd) can jump in to align commercial flexibility for pilot options.

Thanks — Vivek
